interpretation: SNL96-97 assigns 78 frame rivets in eight size groups, plus four M338 brake brackets and two M385 stops.
The 32 rivets of 11/16 x 1.5 inch are tentatively allocated four per gusset/channel joint. The source prints count/size but does not label these locations. The other 46 rivets remain unallocated.

A return flange on each gusset and a diaphragm overlap are mechanical reconstruction hypotheses. Existing simplified flat plates otherwise offer only end or edge contact with upright angles. The figures do not dimension these returns.
Source rivet length is modeled as stock below the factory head before upsetting. Tail-head volume preserves the remaining stock after the grip. Head shape and receiver clearance are estimated.
